**MAAT\-DAT Consulting Inc. recrute : Experts en données et DevOps**

**À PROPOS DE MAAT\-DAT CONSULTING INC.**  
MAAT\-DAT Consulting Inc. est une société de conseil spécialisée en données. En pleine croissance, nous bâtissons une équipe d'experts pour accroître notre capacité à livrer des mandats à forte valeur ajoutée auprès de nos clients. Nous recherchons plusieurs profils pour compléter notre équipe.

**PROFIL 1 – Data Engineer**

**Responsabilités**

* Concevoir, documenter et implanter des pipelines de données évolutifs (API, bases de données, fichiers, temps réel).
* Développer des solutions multinuages (Azure, AWS) sur Databricks et Snowflake.
* Optimiser la performance et les coûts des traitements, et assurer la qualité des données.

**Compétences recherchées**

* 5 ans et plus en ingénierie de données, Python et Spark; 4 ans et plus avec Databricks.
* Snowflake, Azure Data Factory, Azure Data Lake; BigQuery, un atout.
* AWS : S3, Glue, Redshift, Lambda, EMR; Kinesis ou MSK, un atout.
* Solide expérience en SQL, modélisation et entreposage de données.

**PROFIL 2 – Data Scientist**

**Responsabilités**

* Traduire les enjeux d'affaires en solutions d'apprentissage automatique.
* Concevoir, entraîner, mettre en production et surveiller des modèles (performance, dérive, fiabilité).
* Mettre en place des mécanismes d'alerte et de réentraînement selon les bonnes pratiques MLOps.

**Compétences recherchées**

* 5 ans et plus en science des données; maîtrise de Python (pandas, scikit\-learn, PySpark) et de SQL.
* Expérience démontrée en mise en production et monitoring de modèles (data drift, model drift, alertes).
* MLflow, Databricks, SageMaker ou Azure ML; Bedrock, Docker, PyTorch ou TensorFlow, des atouts.
* Maîtrise ou doctorat en statistique, mathématiques ou informatique, un atout.

**PROFIL 3 – Data Architect**

**Responsabilités**

* Définir l'architecture de données cible des clients en lien avec leur stratégie d'affaires.
* Concevoir des architectures multinuages (entrepôt, lac, *lakehouse*, *Data Mesh*) intégrant Databricks et Snowflake.
* Établir les normes de modélisation, de qualité, de sécurité et de gouvernance; contribuer aux avant\-ventes.

**Compétences recherchées**

* 8 ans et plus en données, dont 3 ans en architecture.
* Expertise en modélisation (Kimball, Data Vault, dimensionnelle), Databricks (Unity Catalog) et Snowflake.
* AWS : S3, Glue, Redshift, Athena, Lake Formation, IAM, KMS, VPC; écosystème Azure.
* Connaissance de la gouvernance, des métadonnées et du FinOps.

**PROFIL 4 – DevOps Engineer**

**Responsabilités**

* Concevoir, automatiser et maintenir l'infrastructure infonuagique des plateformes de données (Azure, AWS).
* Mettre en place et optimiser les chaînes CI/CD pour les pipelines de données et les modèles d'apprentissage automatique.
* Assurer la sécurité, la surveillance, la fiabilité et l'optimisation des coûts des environnements.

**Compétences recherchées**

* 5 ans et plus d'expérience en DevOps ou en ingénierie de plateforme infonuagique.
* Expertise en Terraform et en infrastructure en tant que code.
* Maîtrise de GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps Pipelines et des stratégies de déploiement.
* Conteneurisation et orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes, EKS ou AKS).
* AWS : IAM, VPC, EC2, S3, CloudWatch, KMS; équivalents Azure.
* Scripting (Python, Bash) et outils de monitoring (CloudWatch, Azure Monitor, Datadog ou Grafana).
* Connaissance de Databricks et Snowflake, un atout.

**EXIGENCES COMMUNES À TOUS LES PROFILS**

* Maîtrise de GitHub et des pratiques CI/CD; Terraform, un atout (requis pour DevOps).
* Connaissance des méthodologies Agile.
* Baccalauréat en TI, informatique, génie, statistique, mathématiques ou domaine connexe.
* Expérience en contexte de conseil ou de mandats clients, un atout.
* Excellentes aptitudes de communication et de résolution de problèmes.
* Bilinguisme (français et anglais).

**POURQUOI JOINDRE MAAT\-DAT?**

* Une équipe d'experts en croissance et des mandats variés dans plusieurs secteurs.
* Un budget de formation et de certifications (AWS, Azure, Databricks, Snowflake).
* Une rémunération concurrentielle et un mode de travail flexible. *(à préciser)*

**Pour postuler**, envoie ton CV en précisant le profil visé. (info@maatdat.com)

**MAAT\-DAT Consulting Inc. is hiring: Data and DevOps Experts**

MAAT\-DAT Consulting Inc. is a data\-focused consulting firm. As we grow, we are building a team of experts to increase our capacity to deliver high\-value engagements for our clients. We are looking for several profiles to join our team.

The Advanced Technology Centers (ATCs) are the engine for reinvention in our clients’ transformation journey. Powered by more than 255,000 people across 24 countries, ATCs provide our clients with seamless access to industry insights and innovative technology solutions.

The Advanced Technology Centers (ATCs) make a tremendous impact in solving our clients’ business problems by leveraging innovation, intelligence, industry insights, new IT, and new technology skills. With the global environment changing at a faster pace, our clients are facing unprecedented challenges, and they need us more than ever before. As a Network, ATCs are positioned to unlock greater opportunities and exponential value for our clients.

 **The value for our clients and our people:**


For our clients, the Network provides the strength of our geographic diversity, greater resilience, and seamless access to the deepest industry knowledge, the latest in Gen AI solutions, and tech expertise from around the world.


For our people, it brings an opportunity to shape truly boundaryless career paths in a highly collaborative team of experts where they can learn from each other and solve the world’s most complex client challenges.

 **You Are**


A Full Stack Developer with strong experience in Java, J2EE, web technologies, and enterprise application delivery. You bring hands\-on capability across frontend development using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, backend services, SQL, and database management systems. Curam experience is strong asset; candidates with a demonstrated willingness and ability to learn Curam will also be considered. You are also interested in using Agentic AI capabilities to improve development productivity, solution delivery, and user outcomes.

You will be part of a cross\-functional Agile delivery team responsible for designing, building, configuring, testing, deploying, and supporting Curam\-based solutions. You will implement product features across the full technology stack and translate functional requirements into secure, maintainable technical solutions.


You will own or contribute to Curam technical design, user story creation and refinement, application configuration and customization, code implementation, deployment, unit testing, and defect resolution. You will work closely with multidisciplinary partners to ensure solutions meet business, usability, quality, and delivery objectives.

* Develop full stack application components using Java, J2EE, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, SQL, and related web and database technologies.
* Build maintainable, reusable, and testable code that follows established architecture, development, security, and accessibility standards.
* Prepare and deploy application code across development and test environments using established release and configuration\-management processes.
* Perform unit testing, support integration and system testing, analyze defects, and deliver timely bug fixes.
* Troubleshoot application, integration, data, and environment issues and contribute to root\-cause analysis and permanent resolution.
* Participate in code reviews, design reviews, sprint ceremonies, technical discussions, and continuous\-improvement activities.
* Support application releases, production validation, ongoing maintenance, and operational issue resolution.

  

**Here's What You Need: (skills)**

* Bachelor Degree or College Diploma or equivalent work experience
* Atleast 2 \-3 years of overall experience in JAVA development
* Demonstrated experience developing enterprise applications using Java and J2EE technologies.
* Hands\-on experience with frontend web technologies, including HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
* Strong knowledge of SQL, relational data concepts, and database management systems.
* Experience designing and implementing both frontend and backend components for enterprise web applications.
* Experience with object\-oriented design, service integration, application architecture, and secure coding practices.
* Familiarity with Agentic AI concepts and the ability to apply AI\-enabled tools responsibly within software delivery workflows.
* Understanding of the software development lifecycle, Agile delivery practices, and DevOps principles.
* Experience writing unit tests, diagnosing defects, and supporting integration and system testing.
* Experience with build, deployment, configuration\-management, and CI/CD practices.
* Experience using Git or a comparable source\-control system and working effectively in collaborative development workflows.
* Strong problem\-solving, debugging, analytical, and technical documentation skills.
* Excellent communication, teamwork, and stakeholder\-collaboration skills
* Must have Reliability Security Clearance or be eligible to obtain it.
* English is required for this position as this role will regularly interact with stakeholders across Canada, US and other countries across our Global footprint where English is the common language. Due to the significant high volume of interactions with these English\-speaking stakeholders, which is inherent to this position, it is not possible to reorganize the company's activities to avoid this requirement.

 **Nice to have skills:**

* Experience with IBM Curam solutions or willingness to learn it.
* Experience delivering solutions in regulated environments with security, privacy, accessibility, and compliance requirements.
* Experience supporting large\-scale public\-sector or enterprise digital transformation programs.

You’ll immerse yourself in a dynamic hands\-on 24\-month rotation program with access to our innovative leaders, to the latest tools and technologies, and have a chance to shape the future of insurance. You will also have access to professional development courses and received regular performance reviews and feedback sessions.

* Assist in the development and implementation of security policies and procedures
* Conduct vulnerability assessments to identify and prioritize system threats
* Monitor and analyze network traffic for unusual activity and potential threats
* Investigate and respond to security incidents
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to enhance security measures
* Participate in threat intelligence gathering and analysis
* Implement infrastructure security strategies to safeguard environments
* Leverage AI technologies to enhance security insights and decision\-making processes
* Stay current with emerging cybersecurity threats and trends to strengthen defenses

 **What you bring to the table:**

* Recent or soon\-to\-be graduate with a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, graduating by May 2027 or within the past year
* Strong analytical abilities and problem\-solving skills
* Adaptability, curiosity, and a commitment to continuous learning
* Excellent communication skills with a passion for technology
* Self\-reliant with a strong sense of responsibility
* Understanding of network protocols, firewalls, and security technologies
* Familiarity with programming languages such as Python or Java
* For candidates located in Quebec, bilingualism is required considering the necessity to interact on a regular basis with English\-speaking colleagues across the country

 **Your career starts here. Apply today!**

  

If you are passionate about cybersecurity and eager to kickstart your career with hands\-on experience, apply now to join our dynamic team and make a difference in the world of cybersecurity.

  

We’re accepting applications now through October 12th. All submissions will be reviewed during this time, as well as after the posting closes.

 **Position Scope**


We are seeking enthusiastic, talented people to ***act as the first point of contact when our customers have inquiries or encounter issues as they use our software****.*


**Product Analysts** receive tickets and analyze screenshots and details of customer issues, to replicate the problem while proactively communicating with CMiC teams to guide issues to resolution. In addition to providing a very high level of client service, you will develop strong relationships with clients and staff and provide feedback on documentation. Individuals applying for this position must be able to multi\-task, have a strong attention to detail, professional demeanor, and be able to adapt into a growing and changing environment.

**Duties \& Responsibilities**

* Answer client queries and provide basic direction and training on common issues
* Triage product queues and prioritize issues according to their severity
* Conduct web meetings with customers to gather information for investigative purposes or to provide assistance
* Test and duplicate issues in order to document and demonstrate the problem to other teams such as programming
* Participate in project and team meetings; interacting and collaborating with team members
* Leverage and contribute to the Knowledge Base to assist with the resolution of issues
* Relay feedback to Product Managers so that the product can be improved
* Provide feedback to supervisors and managers regarding processes that are unclear and need to be changed

**This role is for you if:**

* You would rather spend most of your time on challenging issues rather than handling simple support requests
* You want to engage in a collaborative environment with helpful co\-workers and accessible leaders and managers
* You prefer to work for a company that listens to its staff and continues to work toward being a Great Place To Work
